finding: The mailbox carries a periodic service exchange, not per-digit commands. The AT control run produces the same seven tags with the same arguments and only 12 messages; the dial run repeats that cycle about 135 times while audio plays. No tag or argument distinguishes digit 1 from 2 from 3.
caveat: In this emulator the digits reach the C52 through bridge.set_dtmf_digits, not the mailbox, so a tap on the mailbox cannot attribute them. The tone attribution in report.txt is an artefact of window overlap: messages repeat every ~7 samples while a DTMF digit lasts thousands, so every window covers whatever is playing. Treat the per-tag tone column in this run as uninformative.
assumptions: The ROM captures cannot run this: they carry no DSP program memory below 0x8000.
Temporal correlation is not causal attribution.
